title: RunListParams
description:
`run.list`'s params: which runs, of every run rlxd knows, live or ended, from before
an app or rlxd restart too.

```json
{"states": ["running", "queued"], "job_id": "j1", "limit": 50}
```

job_id.description: Only the runs this scheduler job fired.

limit.description: At most this many, the latest first.

states.description: Only runs in these states. Absent: every state.

oneOf.description: Waiting for a place in its kind's pool.
It ended needing the user; `run.resume` goes on with it.
It ended without one: `run.failed`'s `reason` says why.
